name: sklearn_unsupervised
label: Sklearn Generic (Unsupervised)
brief: Train scikit-learn unsupervised estimators with automatic preprocessing and artifact registration. Supports KMeans, MiniBatchKMeans, DBSCAN, AgglomerativeClustering, GaussianMixture, IsolationForest, PCA, and related clustering, anomaly detection, and dimensionality reduction workflows.
when_to_use: Any scikit-learn model for clustering, anomaly detection, or dimensionality reduction
KMeans or MiniBatchKMeans for fast segmentation baselines
DBSCAN for density-based clustering with noise handling
GaussianMixture for probabilistic or soft cluster assignments
IsolationForest for anomaly and outlier detection
PCA for dimensionality reduction and latent structure exploration
When no target label is available and the goal is pattern discovery
when_not_to_use: Classification or regression with a known target column — use the supervised skill
Tasks requiring direct supervised metrics such as accuracy, ROC-AUC, or R2
Survival Analysis — use the survival_analysis skill (if available)
GLM with Poisson/Gamma/Tweedie distributions — use the glm skill (if available)
